marta: quick follow-up from the partials/timeouts postmortem. three owners needed: client SDK, server guardrails, alerts/runbook. calling it now.
li: i'll own client SDK. plan: exp-jitter reconnect, max parallel reconnects = 1, add resume token cache TTL 30s. RFC + small SDK change by Tue 2026-03-30.
ken: server guardrails here. defensive frame parsing + sequence-based kv invalidation. add abort for stalled async flushes at 200ms. branch + tests by Mon 2026-03-29.
marta: alerts/runbook owner? need streaming.partial_fragment_rate metric + canary rollback thresholds.
ken: also will add a lightweight continuity test in the serving runtime that flags truncated streams early.
li: SDK reconnect snippet I'll add to RFC: base_ms:100, max_ms:3500, attempts:5, jitter:full. will include telemetry reconnect_reason and resume_success.
marta: rollout plan: 3% canary -> 15% -> 50% -> full over 36h if partial_fragment_rate stable. rollback if >0.4% or 99p latency +20%.
pager-bot: created INC-6011 (client-sdk), INC-6012 (server-guardrails), INC-6013 (streaming-observability). Links: https://tracker/redwood/INC-6011, https://tracker/redwood/INC-6012, https://tracker/redwood/INC-6013
li: acked, will open RFC today.
ken: acked, starting tests now.
marta: i'll schedule a 15m check-in Wed 2026-04-01 09:00am PT to validate canary readiness. include smoke steps in PRs. closing for now.
